turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Why was my son's mark changed without anyone calling me?
Please. Who decided on the zero?
If you escalate this, I'll make sure the academic integrity committee sees everything, including his two late assignments from September.
Is that a threat, Hale? Two late assignments from September have nothing to do with whether anyone checked this essay before entering a zero.
Then it's the principal's office, and your threat goes in my email. Who decided on the zero?
